title: Freeze Tags
statement: Implement `solve(tags)`. Strip each tag and drop empties. Return the remaining tags as a list, which is the JSON form of the tuple you would store so a caller cannot append. Do not unique them. Order stays.
constraints: Empty tags after strip are dropped
hints: Keep the non-empty ones in order.
Returning a list is the frozen sequence the judge can compare. Building a tuple first is the right Python, then list() it.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A tuple of tags cannot be appended to.

editorial: A tuple of tags cannot be appended to. That is the freeze. The judge wants a list with the same items so the expected JSON is a list. Constructing the tuple and converting it makes the immutability step real without changing the values.
